conbody.p: A project can have a cover photo, shown across the top of its Overview and beside the project in All projects. Before there is one, a slim box at the top of the page offers Add a cover photo; choose a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image. A large photo is scaled down in your browser before it is saved, and a file over 5 MB is refused. Once there is a cover, it runs across the whole page, with the project's four figures (traced, verified, failing and suspect) along its foot, so the panels beside the definition start higher up. Change cover in the photo's top corner replaces it and Remove takes it away; the figures then go back to the top of their column. Anyone who can see the project sees its cover; changing it takes an editor.
